tagline: Mission-critical intelligence solutions for security and law enforcement
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue represents nearly half of total revenue, reflecting a loyal installed base and deep customer integration in a high-barrier market, reinforced by growing adoption of operational AI.

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that renews each year, often tied to maintenance or subscription contracts.
kpis.description: Recurring revenue amounts to $188.4M for FYE26 (47.1% of total revenue), indicating strong revenue recurrence in customer relationships.
kpis.signal: 47.1% of total revenue: predictable and sticky model

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales generated by the company over a given period.
kpis.description: Total revenue for FYE26 amounts to $400.0M, up 14% year-over-year.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Non-GAAP gross margin is 73% for FYE26, an improvement of 200 basis points year-on-year.
kpis.signal: High gross margin typical of software publishers

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for certain non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA reaches $48M in FYE26, up 66% compared to the prior year, driven by strong operational execution.

kpis.name: Short-Term RPO
kpis.explanation: Predictable revenue over the next 12 months from signed contracts.
kpis.description: Short-Term RPO stands at $369.5M as of Q4 FYE26, indicating strong visibility into future revenue.

kpis.name: Billings
kpis.explanation: Invoiced revenue, including changes in contract liabilities.
kpis.description: Billings reach $109.9M in Q4 FYE26, an increase compared to prior quarters.
kpis.signal: Quarterly billings up to $109.9M in Q4

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last five reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.4B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last five reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$0.001B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: AI in Action
kpis.explanation: Use of artificial intelligence directly within customers' operational workflows.
kpis.description: AI is embedded into operational workflows, strengthening competitive advantage and perceived value in sensitive environments.
kpis.signal: AI is central to product differentiation

kpis.name: Customer Expansion
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth from existing customers through upsells and cross-sells.
kpis.description: The company leverages a long-standing installed customer base, with an active expansion strategy in national security and law enforcement segments.
kpis.signal: Loyal customer base with strong expansion potential

risks.title: Dependence on government contracts and budget cycles
risks.score_rationale: Major risk positioned at the beginning of Item 3.D, with intense language ("substantial majority", "foreseeable future"). Cognyte is highly dependent on volatile government budgets. Trend is stable but structural. High categorical weight for a B2G company.

risks.title: Customer concentration and limited investor visibility
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the risk summary and detailed in Item 3.D. Clear language on significant concentration. Trend is stable. Direct impact on revenue predictability and valuation.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and regional instability
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the summary ("geopolitical changes", "Israel's conflicts"). Moderate-to-high intensity language. Cognyte operates internationally with exposure to Israel. Trend is up (current geopolitical context). Significant categorical weight.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and product vulnerabilities
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in the risk summary ("defects, operational problems, or vulnerability to cyber-attacks"). Direct language. Cognyte provides sensitive investigative analytics solutions. Trend is stable but critical. High categorical weight for a cybersecurity/intelligence company.

risks.title: Handling of sensitive data and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the summary ("mishandling or perceived mishandling of sensitive, confidential or classified information"). High-alert language. Cognyte handles classified government data. Trend is stable but critical. Very high categorical weight.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: Listed in the summary ("complex and changing regulatory environments"). Moderate language. Cognyte operates across multiple jurisdictions with differing regulatory requirements. Trend is up (increasing regulation). Moderate-to-high categorical weight.

risks.title: Long sales cycles and solution complexity
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the summary ("long sales cycles and sophisticated nature of our solutions"). Clear language. Impacts revenue predictability and cash flow. Trend is stable. Moderate categorical weight.

risks.title: Aggressive competition and rapid technological change
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the summary ("aggressive competition in all of our markets", "keep pace with technological advances"). Moderate-to-high language intensity. Structural sector risk. Trend is up (AI, innovation). Moderate categorical weight.

ai_positioning.summary: Cognyte strategically integrates AI into its operational workflows, leveraging its domain expertise and ability to process large-scale sensitive data. AI is not an add-on, but a core component of its platform.
evidence: AI in Action: embedded into workflows for operational outcomes
Data Advantage: unifying fragmented, high-sensitivity data at scale
Domain Expertise: decades of investigative methodologies embedded in the platform
